blocks.en: In applications, $\bm{n}$ is usually a coordinate direction associated with time. In this case, let us set $\bm{x}=(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_{n-1},t)$ and let $\bm{\xi}=(\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_{n-1},0)$ be a spatial vector.
blocks.zh: 在应用中, $\bm{n}$ 通常是与时间相联系的坐标方向. 此时, 令 $\bm{x}=(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_{n-1},t)$, 并令 $\bm{\xi}=(\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_{n-1},0)$ 为空间向量.

blocks.en: For rapidly oscillating functions of small support, we may think of the coefficients of $L^p$ as approximately constant; let us assume they are constant. If $\omega$ is a root of \eqref{eq:strict-hyperbolic-characteristic-roots}, then $u=\exp(i(\bm{\xi}\cdot\bm{x})+i\omega t)$ is a solution of $L^pu=0$. If $\omega$ has negative imaginary part, then this solution grows exponentially in time. Moreover, since $L^p$ is homogeneous of degree $m$, i.e., $L^p(\bm{x},\lambda(i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n}))=\lambda^mL^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n})$ for any scalar $\lambda$, there are always roots with negative imaginary parts if there are any roots which are not real (if we change the sign of $\bm{\xi}$, we also change the sign of $\omega$). Moreover, if we multiply $\bm{\xi}$ by a scalar factor $\lambda$, then $\omega$ is multiplied by the same factor, and hence solutions would grow more and more rapidly the faster they oscillate in space. The condition that the roots in \eqref{eq:strict-hyperbolic-characteristic-roots} are real is therefore a necessary condition for well-posedness of initial-value problems.
blocks.zh: 对于支集很小且快速振荡的函数, 可以将 $L^p$ 的系数看作近似常数; 现在假设它们就是常数. 如果 $\omega$ 是 \eqref{eq:strict-hyperbolic-characteristic-roots} 的根, 那么 $u=\exp(i(\bm{\xi}\cdot\bm{x})+i\omega t)$ 是 $L^pu=0$ 的一个解. 如果 $\omega$ 的虚部为负, 这一解就随时间指数增长. 此外, 由于 $L^p$ 是 $m$ 次齐次的, 即对任意标量 $\lambda$ 有 $L^p(\bm{x},\lambda(i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n}))=\lambda^mL^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n})$, 所以只要有非实根, 就总有虚部为负的根 (如果改变 $\bm{\xi}$ 的符号, 也就改变了 $\omega$ 的符号). 再者, 如果将 $\bm{\xi}$ 乘以标量因子 $\lambda$, 则 $\omega$ 也乘以同一因子, 因而解在空间振荡得越快, 其增长就会越快. 所以 \eqref{eq:strict-hyperbolic-characteristic-roots} 中的根为实数, 是初值问题适定的一个必要条件.

blocks.en: Note that, since we assumed that the components of $\bm{L}^p$ are of first order, we have $\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n})=\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi})+\omega\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{n})$; hence the problem $\det\bm{L}^p=0$ is a matrix eigenvalue problem for $\omega$. If the eigenvalues are distinct, there is always a complete set of eigenvectors; hence strict hyperbolicity implies hyperbolicity.
blocks.zh: 注意, 由于已假设 $\bm{L}^p$ 的分量都是一阶的, 有 $\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi}+i\omega\bm{n})=\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{\xi})+\omega\bm{L}^p(\bm{x},i\bm{n})$; 因而问题 $\det\bm{L}^p=0$ 是关于 $\omega$ 的矩阵特征值问题. 如果特征值互异, 就总存在一组完备的特征向量; 所以严格双曲性蕴含双曲性.

blocks.en: In general, we need to be careful about defining the "principal part" of a system. A naive approach of simply taking the "terms of highest order" turns out to be unsatisfactory.
blocks.zh: 一般地, 定义方程组的"主部"时需要谨慎. 简单地取"最高阶项"这一朴素方法并不令人满意.

blocks.en: The term "order" for systems is used with two different meanings. Such terms as "first-order" or "second-order" systems usually refer to the equations of which the system is composed. However, it is also possible to assign an order to the system as a whole. This order is defined as the degree of the symbol of $\det\bm{L}^p$, which is equal to $\sum_{i,j}s_i+t_j$.
blocks.zh: 对方程组使用"阶"这个术语时, 有两种不同含义. "一阶"或"二阶"方程组等术语, 通常指组成方程组的各个方程. 不过, 也可以为整个方程组指定一个阶. 这一阶定义为 $\det\bm{L}^p$ 的符号的次数, 它等于 $\sum_{i,j}s_i+t_j$.

blocks.en: Nonlinear Equations
blocks.zh: 非线性方程
blocks.label: subsec:nonlinear-classification

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
For nonlinear equations and systems, the type can depend not only on the point in space but on the solution itself. We simply linearize the equation at a given solution and define the type to be that of the linearized equation. Characteristic surfaces are similarly defined as the characteristic surfaces of the linearized equation.

For future use we give the definition of quasilinear and semilinear:
blocks.zh:
对于非线性方程和方程组, 类型不仅可能依赖于空间中的点, 还可能依赖于解本身. 只需在给定解处将方程线性化, 并将其类型定义为线性化方程的类型. 类似地, 将特征曲面定义为线性化方程的特征曲面.

为以后使用, 给出拟线性和半线性的定义:

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A system is called \textbf{quasilinear} if derivatives of principal order occur only linearly (with coefficients which may depend on derivatives of lower order). It is called \textbf{semilinear} if it is quasilinear and the coefficients of the terms of principal order depend only on $\bm{x}$, but not on the solution.
blocks.zh: 如果最高阶导数只线性地出现 (其系数可以依赖于低阶导数), 则称方程组为\textbf{拟线性的}. 如果它是拟线性的, 且最高阶项的系数只依赖于 $\bm{x}$ 而不依赖于解, 则称其为\textbf{半线性的}.
blocks.label: def:quasilinear-semilinear

blocks.en:
Determine the type of the following equations:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $u_{xy}+2u_x=0$.
\item $u_{xxxx}-u_{xxyy}+u_{yyyy}=0$.
\item $u_{tt}+u_{xxxx}=0$.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
确定下列方程的类型:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $u_{xy}+2u_x=0$.
\item $u_{xxxx}-u_{xxyy}+u_{yyyy}=0$.
\item $u_{tt}+u_{xxxx}=0$.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:determine-pde-types

\item $xu_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$.

blocks.en:
Consider the first-order equation $yu_x+(x^2+1)u_y=0$.
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item Determine the characteristics.
\item Show that the most general solution is any function which is constant along characteristics and use this fact to give a formula for the general solution.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
考虑一阶方程 $yu_x+(x^2+1)u_y=0$.
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item 确定其特征.
\item 证明, 最一般的解是沿特征为常数的任意函数, 并利用这一事实给出通解公式.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:first-order-characteristic-solution
